observations.behavior: Adds snapshot entries for new metric card variants.
observations.posthog_connection: These hashes establish baseline visual expectations for dashboard cards in PostHog's Marketing Analytics; without them, future UI changes could break tests or allow unnoticed regressions.

observations.behavior: Renders a preview of metric and notice cards with loading and missing-spec states.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an implementation and testable behavior for configuring metric cards on dashboards, including handling setup actions when conversion goals are not configured.

observations.behavior: Returns null instead of rendering an empty grid cell when no spec is provided.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the dashboard layout to remain intact while omitting unavailable metrics rather than displaying broken placeholders, supporting configuration-dependent views.

observations.limitations: Only frontend and storybook-related hunks are supplied. Backend ingestion, warehouse connectors, query execution and shared infrastructure are absent, so broader systemic benefit cannot be established.

review.limitations: Only frontend and storybook-related hunks are supplied. Backend ingestion, warehouse connectors, query execution and shared infrastructure are absent, so broader systemic benefit cannot be established.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a bounded capability improvement: adding configurable metric-card components, their stories and snapshots, along with appropriate TypeScript support. This supports marketing-analytics dashboard correctness and maintainability but does not show cross-component reach or critical-path risk reduction.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds supported card variants and visual regression baselines; could help prevent UI regressions in Marketing Analytics dashboards.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; backend and wider integration context is missing.
